en:
<CLT=cltMIND>An entire indoor tennis court...
This is impressive...

This is your lab, right, Ryoma?
Must be nice, having a whole tennis court here.

Hmph, I don't care. I have nothing
to do with tennis anymore.
<CLT=cltMIND>Nothing to do with tennis?

Ryoma...are you really not
going to play tennis anymore?

Tennis? Who the hell plays a hoity-toity sport
like tennis?

Ohhhh, that's right. I totally forgot.
You're a tennis player, aren'tcha?

It's fine if you forget. That was a long
time ago.

So when you killed a mafia with your badass
tennis skills, was that a long time ago too!?
H-Hey! Come on, Miu...
What? It really happened, yeah?
Yeah...it's true.

Thanks to that...even if I escape from here, 
I'll just go straight to a different prison.

Hmph...so it'd be meaningless for someone
like me to play tennis now...

<CLT=cltMIND>...Then why are you staring at that
tennis court with such sad eyes, Ryoma?

Are you a little bitch!? Cuz you're actin'
like a little bitch right now!

Wh-What's with the staredown?
You're...scaring me...

The only thing waiting for me 
when I get out of here...is prison.

So it'd be meaningless for someone 
like me to play tennis now...
Ooooh! Now *this* is an interesting machine!

An interesting machine...?
You mean the one swinging the racquet?

With a few mods, this bad boy'll look real
good! Yeah, my creative juices are flowin'!

Heh, heh heh heh...
Big metal arm... Heh...heh heh heh...

<CLT=cltMIND>Coming from her, it *has* to be
inappropriate. I have a bad feeling about this...

Heh heh heh heh...
Big metal arm... Heh heh heh heh...
<CLT=cltMIND>...I'm just gonna leave her alone.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is there a closet or something
in the back?
There's a shower room in the back.

A shower room! Why don't you boys go in
and give each other a good scrubdown!?
You're already the perfect height, Ryoma!

You'll be lined up juuuuust right when you
turn around to face Shuichi!

I-I was just kidding...
I-I thought you'd laugh...

<CLT=cltMIND>This looks like a shower room.
...I don't have to take a shower right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>A tennis net...
It's stretched tight and looks sturdy.
